name: Night Harbour Navy
motif: 夜の港と海軍 — セーラー服、信号旗、真鍮の舷窓、ロープ。色は紺と白と赤でまとめたい
tone: crisp naval, calm night (凛々しい・夜の静けさ)
concept: opaque navy serge with white sailor-collar piping, red signal-flag CTA on a rope halyard, brass portholes and nameplate, a dressing line of signal flags as the nav, harbour lights and a lighthouse beam behind

allow.navy: The posted motif is a navy (海軍) at a night harbour and the user asked for 紺・白・赤: navy serge is the uniform cloth, kept opaque and paired with white collar piping, brass and signal-flag red
allow.monochrome: User limited the colours to navy, white and red; brass is the only extra and comes from the motif (真鍮の舷窓)
